t: Allthemodium armour has several benefits other than just the armour, toughness and knockback resistance:$(li)Water Breathing$(li)No Crash Damage when Flying with Elytra$(li)Immune to Fire Damage$(li)No Fall Damage$(li)When you upgrade the armour from Netherite, it keeps the enchants
